title: Quarterly roadmap weave and cross-org commitment protocol
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Problem: Our company-level OKRs span multiple initiatives owned across Eng, Design, and Platform. Current planning artifacts are siloed (team-level roadmaps, scattered spreadsheets) which leads to asynchronous commitments, repeated rework, and unclear rollback lanes. Goal: Create a repeatable 'weave' process and a Commitment Protocol that produces a single source initiative map aligned to company OKRs each quarter, with clear confidence bands, interlock owners, and guardrails for rollouts and fallbacks. Scope: 1) Define commitment windows and decision rights for PM/Eng/Design/Infra. 2) Deliver a canonical initiative map (tile-based) that links initiatives -> OKR key results -> milestones -> risks. 3) Publish a lightweight Commitment Protocol doc + checklist for release managers. 4) Wire up visualization in Console/Operations dashboards to show per-initiative health (latency, cost, quality regressions) and delivery confidence. Deliverables: - Commitment Protocol doc (Confluence) - Initiative Tile Map (canonical spreadsheet + CSV export) - Playbook for cross-functional interlocks & escalation - Dashboard mock + simple prototype feed (metrics + readiness flags) Success metrics (initial): - 80% of company-level initiatives signed off within commitment window by all interlock owners. - Decrease cross-team replan incidents by 40% quarter-over-quarter. - 90% of initiative tiles include at least 1 measurable leading indicator. Constraints & trade-offs: - Minimizing ceremony vs. ensuring alignment: protocol must be light (<= 45 minute interlock sync) but produce structured outputs. - Tooling lift: initial phase uses shared spreadsheet + Confluence; dashboards will be incrementally integrated (Console tagging + a small telemetry pipeline). Stakeholders: Exec PMs (Aisha), Eng Leads (Marco, Priya), Design Leads (Elena), Platform & Infra (Samir), GTM (Julian). Risks & mitigations: - Risk: Teams treat protocol as optional -> mitigate by making Commitment Protocol part of release gating for company OKR initiatives. - Risk: Metrics telemetry gaps -> mitigation: onboarding checklist & temporary manual health flags. Timeline & milestones: - 2025-11-12: Draft protocol & sample tile map (this ticket created). - 2025-11-20: PM leadership review & get buy-in from Eng/Design. - 2025-12-05: Pilot with 3 initiatives (one infra, one runtime, one console). - 2026-01-15: Full rollout for 2026-Q1 planning cycle. Long-term: Integrate the initiative map with Console release dashboards and create automatic exports for leadership reports.
comments: 2025-11-12 — Aisha Kapoor: Created initial ticket and sketch of the weave concept. Uploaded initial prototype tile map (spreadsheet) to Drive. Asked Marco to coordinate Eng interlock responses.

Agreed on 'initiative tile' shape: objective, OKR mapping, milestones (M0-M3), owners, confidence band (Low/Medium/High), leading indicators.
